newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Duta pays 130 rph dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bank Duta pays 130 rph dividend for 1996.

text.p: Indonesia's large privately-owned Bank Duta said on Tuesday it would pay a dividend of 130 rupiah per share for 1996 compared with 125 rupiah in 1995.
The bank said in a statement its shareholders approved the proposed dividend payment at a meeting in Jakarta on Tuesday and added details of the payment would be announced later.
Bank Duta said its shareholders had also approved a plan to split the nominal price of its stock to 500 rupiah from 1,000 rupiah per share to boost liquidity.
Bank Duta was up 75 rupiah at 1,925 rupiah at 0650 GMT, with some 300,000 shares traded.
